ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (16) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Предание» (predanie) is 'tradition' and «уяснение» (uyasnenie) 'clarification'; «внушение ложной веры детям» (vnushenie lozhnoy very detyam) is 'the instilling of false faith in children'. Tolstoy's '1/1000' is kept in digits.
